definitions.gloss: offering, presenting (to a superior or deity)
definitions.explanation: The act of respectfully presenting a gift or tribute to someone of higher status, such as royalty, a deity, or a distinguished person. Implies deference and formality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天皇|てんのう}→天皇：04546_tennou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{献上|けんじょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To present an offering to the Emperor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{特産品|とくさんひん}→特産品：13483_tokusanhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{皇室|こうしつ}→皇室：11339_koushitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{献上|けんじょう}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Local specialties were presented to the Imperial Family.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{茶園|ちゃえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{抹茶|まっちゃ}→抹茶：10574_maccha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{江戸時代|えどじだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{将軍|しょうぐん}→将軍：12386_shougun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{献上|けんじょう}⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{由緒|ゆいしょ}→由緒：13567_yuisho⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{品|しな}→品：03192_shina⟧だ。
examples.english: The matcha from this tea garden is a distinguished product that has been presented to the shogun since the Edo period.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word used when presenting something to a person of very high status, particularly the Emperor, the Imperial Family, or (historically) the shogun. In modern usage, it also appears in marketing to indicate premium quality — products labeled {献上|けんじょう}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ suggest they are of a caliber worthy of being presented to royalty.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{献上|けんじょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to present to ~
- {献上|けんじょう}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be presented (passive, often used in descriptions)
- {献上|けんじょう}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧: a tribute gift, an offering

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {献上|けんじょう}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧: tribute gift, offering
- {献上|けんじょう}{米|まい}: rice presented to the Emperor
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{献上|けんじょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to present to ~
